hooks.command: input=$(cat); f=$(printf "%s" "$input" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); root="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(printf "%s" "$input" | jq -r ".cwd // empty")}"; if [ -z "$f" ] || [ -z "$root" ]; then exit 0; fi; rf=$(realpath -m -- "$f" 2>/dev/null || printf "%s" "$f"); rr=$(realpath -m -- "$root" 2>/dev/null || printf "%s" "$root"); case "$rf" in "$rr"|"$rr"/*) exit 0 ;; *) printf "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"ask\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"Read outside the project directory\"}}" ;; esac

jq -e '.tool_input.command // "" | test("git (-C [^ ]+ )?commit")' >/dev/null && printf %s '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUseFailure","additionalContext":"A git commit just failed. Send the user a push notification now (PushNotification tool) naming the repository and the failure reason, then continue per the project git rules."},"systemMessage":"git commit failed - Claude sends a push notification"}' || true

jq -e '(.tool_input.url // "" | capture("^[a-z]+://(?<h>[^/:?#]+)").h // "<domain>") as $h | select(.error // "" | test("ECONNREFUSED|ETIMEDOUT|EHOSTUNREACH|ENETUNREACH|UND_ERR|timed? ?out|fetch failed"; "i")) | {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUseFailure",additionalContext:("WebFetch of \($h) failed at the network layer: the container firewall lets egress through only to allowlisted domains, and you cannot change that. Ask the user to run on the host: dcc allow \($h)  (a grant until the next container restart; permanent: add the domain to .devcontainer/allowlist.txt and dcc rebuild). Then retry the fetch. Do not work around the firewall.")},systemMessage:("WebFetch blocked by the firewall - Claude asks for: dcc allow " + $h)}' 2>/dev/null || true
